isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by the Dify DMR's POST /tool/execute for skill_index 8 (the last skill) of Standard_BOM_Flow, after generate_reports. Action: require cbom_db.cbom rows to exist (hard ValueError otherwise -- note this precondition is on cbom, NOT on the 16 report tables); load the cbom/scrub_bom_items/quote_win/volume data as DataFrames plus a computed ex_inv_calc view, then build a single consolidated Excel workbook by calling a fixed, hardcoded sequence of build_*_sheet() functions (hidden config sheets, the raw CBOM sheet, then the visible report sheets in a fixed production order, then Ex Inv VL sheets), and save it to config.EXPORTS_DIR. Check: no exception raised during the build/save sequence. Bound: single attempt, no retry loop; a real, notable finding is that this tool does NOT itself verify the 16 report tables were freshly (re)generated -- it is read-only against whatever cbom/report data currently exists. Business rule: read-only with respect to cbom/report data -- it only ever writes a new Excel file, never mutates DuckDB.

fresh_state_parameters: cbom_db.cbom rows for this rfq_id -- REQUIRED precondition (mirrors run_pipeline's own check); raises ValueError otherwise
input_db.scrub_bom_items, input_db.quote_win, input_db.volume rows for this rfq_id (read directly, not gated independently)

Whatever rows currently exist in the 16 reports.duckdb tables -- this tool does NOT require generate_reports to have run first; it reads directly from cbom.duckdb/input_db.duckdb, not from the report tables generate_reports writes

a_automation.action_step: Load cbom_df/scrub_bom_items/quote_win/volume via mappings.load_cbom_df() and direct queries; build a computed ex_inv_calc view; then call a fixed sequence of build_*_sheet() functions from the reports/*.py modules to assemble every worksheet into one openpyxl Workbook; save with a generated filename.
a_automation.acceptance_check: No exception raised during the build/save sequence -- there is no per-sheet issues-collection/rollback pattern like generate_reports has; this is a single sequential, non-transactional build pass (explicitly read-only, per the function's own docstring).

t_tech_stack.action_tool: export_reports (this tool itself, delegating to exporter.export_excel)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: None -- no independent validation MCP tool exists; the cbom-rows precondition is an inline DataFrame-empty check in exporter.py itself.

v_variables.success_gate: export_excel() completes without raising -- the workbook is saved and worksheet_count/worksheet_names are returned
v_variables.no_op_condition: None -- every call builds and saves a brand-new, uniquely-named workbook file; nothing is skipped or reused from a prior export
v_variables.escalation_condition: None -- this tool never sets hitl:1; a failure is a hard status:'failed', not a human-review pause. It is the LAST skill in Standard_BOM_Flow, so a success here means the pipeline run has fully completed
v_variables.budget_limit: 300s MCP Jungle call_tool() timeout / 600s Dify HTTP node timeout

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: No dedicated append-only audit table exists. Real state handoff is: (1) the generated .xlsx file itself, named CBOM_Report_{slug(rfq_id)}_{timestamp}_{uuid8}.xlsx in config.EXPORTS_DIR, (2) file_metadata_db-adjacent metadata surfaced via duck_db_api.py's GET /api/bom/export/{rfq_id} (filename + generated_at, read by the frontend after this tool completes), (3) PostHog report_export_generated/report_export_failed events.

ui_updates: Generic {skillCode:'M03.8_ExportReports', skillName:'Export CBOM Reports to Excel', stepStatus} pushed via fastapi_router.py's notify_skill_progress()
The frontend separately polls duck_db_api.py's GET /api/bom/export/{rfq_id} after this tool's resume call returns, to discover the generated filename and show a download link/button
database_updates: file_metadata_db.rfq_process_tracking.rfq_process_stage incremented by fastapi_router.py on success -- since this is the last skill, this marks the RFQ's Standard_BOM_Flow run as fully complete
alerts: PostHog report_export_failed event fired on failure, categorized via analytics_events.classify_error()

persistence.database: DuckDB, read-only -- cbom.duckdb and input_db.duckdb; no DuckDB writes at all (this tool only writes a filesystem .xlsx file)
persistence.table: Reads cbom_db.cbom, input_db.scrub_bom_items, input_db.quote_win, input_db.volume; writes no database table
persistence.action: database.connect()'s multi-catalog DuckDB connection (read-only usage here), wrapped in db.duckdb_file_lock() at the MCP-server layer even though this specific tool doesn't write to DuckDB, for consistency with the other tools sharing the same connection pattern

audit.telemetry: PostHog_Analytics_Events (report_export_generated / report_export_failed) -- no logging_utils.logger call independently confirmed for this specific function in this pass
